info.title: DokiTool Unified Media & Personal Agent API
info.summary: Unified Media v1 (schema_version=1.0) parsing, lazy item resolution, platform catalog, and owner telemetry API.
info.description: Machine-readable contract for DokiTool's public Unified Media v1 endpoints and Bearer API Channels (`Authorization: Bearer <token>`, supporting both `DOKITOOL_OWNER_TOKEN` and named SHA-256 keys from `DOKITOOL_API_KEYS_FILE` across `owner`, `agent`, and `friend` roles). Never pass tokens in query parameters: query-parameter tokens are ignored without error on `/api/parse`, `/api/resolve`, and `/api/platforms` (treating the request as an anonymous visitor while leaking the secret into access logs and shell history), and rejected on `/api/stats`. Never forward `Authorization` or `Cookie` headers to third-party media CDNs.

servers.description: Public DokiTool deployment (replace with your own origin when self-hosting)

get.summary: List enabled media platforms and capabilities
get.description: Returns the active platform catalog for this server instance. Accepts anonymous requests as well as `owner`, `agent`, and `friend` Bearer keys (authenticated calls use the zero-slot fast-read path without consuming per-key concurrency slots).

get.summary: Parse a share URL or share text into Unified Media v1 items
get.description: Extracts normalized media items, variants, and direct CDN delivery sources for a supported public post using two-tier routing: Tier-1 matches registered core catalog domains first with unchanged platform adapters and quotas; when `DOKITOOL_YTDLP_GENERIC_ENABLED` is active and `platform` is omitted or `all`, Tier-2 routes valid public non-catalog URLs (<= 2048 bytes, no fragment/localhost/internal/self-domain/empty path+query) through an isolated generic slow admission pool (`PARSE_GENERIC`) to named yt-dlp extractors (strictly disabling the blind `generic` web scraper), returning a normalized dynamic `data.platform` (cached up to 60s; unsupported sites return 400 `UNSUPPORTED_PLATFORM`). Explicit `platform=<id>` and `/api/resolve` never trigger Tier-2 generic fallback. Accepts optional Bearer credentials (`DOKITOOL_OWNER_TOKEN` or named SHA-256 keys from `DOKITOOL_API_KEYS_FILE` with `owner`, `agent`, or `friend` roles): each key uses an isolated per-key execution pool (`concurrency`, `slow_concurrency`, rate bucket, and FIFO queue) instead of the anonymous per-IP rate limiter, enforces optional per-key `platforms` scope (non-empty allowlists must explicitly include `"ytdlp_generic"` to access Tier-2 generic fallback, returning HTTP 401 `INVALID_INPUT` for disallowed platforms/scopes), and serves fresh in-process cache hits via the post-auth zero-slot cache fast-path without consuming per-key concurrency slots. Tokens passed in query parameters (e.g. `?token=...`) are ignored without error and processed as anonymous visitor requests.

get.summary: Lazily resolve a deferred multipart item (e.g. Bilibili P2..Pn)
get.description: Resolves a specific `deferred` item using the exact `resolve_url` parameters (`url`, `item_id`, `platform`) returned by `/api/parse`. Accepts optional `owner`, `agent`, and `friend` Bearer credentials (`DOKITOOL_OWNER_TOKEN` or `DOKITOOL_API_KEYS_FILE`), enforcing optional per-key `platforms` scope (HTTP 401 `INVALID_INPUT` when disallowed), serving fresh cache hits via the post-auth zero-slot cache fast-path without consuming per-key concurrency slots, and isolating uncached resolutions in the caller key's pool.

200.description: Normalized Unified Media v1 response with the target item resolved.

get.summary: Read in-process aggregate runtime telemetry snapshot (owner role required)
get.description: Returns bounded-cardinality aggregate request, cache, admission queue, per-key API key pool (`api_keys`), yt-dlp slot, Shanghai resolver, parse latency, read-only runtime configuration switches (`runtime`), and rolling Asia/Shanghai (UTC+8) 30-day (`daily`) and 24-hour (`hourly`) bucket metrics. Strictly requires an `owner`-role Bearer credential (`DOKITOOL_OWNER_TOKEN` or an `owner`-role key in `DOKITOOL_API_KEYS_FILE`); valid `agent` or `friend` keys receive HTTP 401 (`code: "INVALID_INPUT"`, `retryable: false`) without charging the anonymous IP bucket, while missing, disabled, or invalid tokens return HTTP 401 and charge the anonymous per-IP burst bucket. Authenticated `owner` calls do not consume a concurrency slot or increment parse request counters, and any unrecognized query parameter or trailing bare `?` returns HTTP 400 (`INVALID_INPUT`).

BearerAuth.description: Bearer API credential read from `DOKITOOL_OWNER_TOKEN` (implicit `id: "owner"`, `role: "owner"`) or named SHA-256 keys configured in `DOKITOOL_API_KEYS_FILE` (`owner`, `agent`, and `friend` roles; up to 64 total keys; 32-512 printable non-whitespace ASCII bytes; total `Authorization` header <= 1024 bytes). Invalid, disabled (`enabled: false`), malformed, duplicate, or oversized headers—or requests when no matching enabled key exists—return HTTP 401 (`code: "INVALID_INPUT"`) and consume the anonymous per-IP burst bucket (`Burst=4`, `0.2/s`), turning repeated failures into HTTP 429 (`code: "RATE_LIMITED"`). Valid `agent` or `friend` keys calling `/api/stats`, or keys requesting a platform outside their per-key `platforms` allowlist (including Tier-2 generic fallback when a non-empty allowlist omits `"ytdlp_generic"`), also receive HTTP 401 (`code: "INVALID_INPUT"`, `retryable: false`, guarded by the per-key fast-read bucket without charging the anonymous IP bucket). Tokens in query parameters (e.g. `?token=...`) are never accepted: on `/api/parse`, `/api/resolve`, and `/api/platforms` they are ignored without error and processed as anonymous visitor requests (while exposing the secret in logs and shell history); only `/api/stats` rejects extra query parameters with HTTP 400 (`INVALID_INPUT`) once authenticated.

RetryAfter.description: Positive integer seconds to wait before retrying.

SchemaVersionRequired.name: schema_version
SchemaVersionRequired.description: Contract version (`1.0`). Missing, array-valued (`schema_version[]=`), or mismatched values return HTTP 409 (`INVALID_INPUT`).

SchemaVersionOptional.name: schema_version
SchemaVersionOptional.description: Optional contract version (`1.0`). Omitting returns v1.0; any other value returns HTTP 409 (`INVALID_INPUT`).

ShareUrl.name: url
ShareUrl.description: Share URL or share text containing an http(s) URL (<= 8192 bytes; <= 2048 bytes on yt-dlp platforms).

PlatformFilter.name: platform
PlatformFilter.description: Optional expected core platform ID (`all` or omitted for automatic Tier-1 catalog detection, plus Tier-2 named-extractor generic fallback on `/api/parse` when `DOKITOOL_YTDLP_GENERIC_ENABLED` is active).

ItemId.name: item_id
ItemId.description: Opaque deferred item identifier from `item.resolve_url` (1..256 printable non-whitespace ASCII bytes).

DebugFlag.name: debug
DebugFlag.description: Set to `1` to include diagnostic normalized variants prior to default product folding.

BadRequestFailure.description: Invalid input parameter, unknown query parameter on `/api/stats`, or unsupported platform (`INVALID_INPUT` / `UNSUPPORTED_PLATFORM`).

UnauthorizedFailure.description: Invalid, disabled (`enabled: false`), malformed, duplicate, or oversized (> 1024 B) `Authorization` header, missing header on `/api/stats`, non-`owner` (`agent` / `friend`) key calling `/api/stats`, or request for a platform outside the caller key's `platforms` allowlist. Always returns JSON `code: "INVALID_INPUT"` (`error.code: "INVALID_INPUT"`, `error.retryable: false`); unauthenticated/invalid token attempts deduct 1 token from the anonymous per-IP burst bucket (`Burst=4`, recovery `0.2/s`), while role/platform denials on valid keys charge the key's fast-read bucket.

UpstreamBlockedFailure.description: Target post requires login, age verification, or was blocked by upstream access control (`UPSTREAM_BLOCKED`).

NotFoundFailure.description: Post contains no supported media (`NO_MEDIA`) or content/item does not exist (`CONTENT_UNAVAILABLE`).

SchemaVersionConflictFailure.description: Missing, array-valued, or unsupported `schema_version` (`INVALID_INPUT`). Authenticated Bearer requests receive actionable guidance copy (`请传入必需查询参数 schema_version=1.0（详见 docs/AGENT-API.md）`) while anonymous requests preserve the browser refresh notice.

RateLimitedFailure.description: Rate limit or admission queue timeout/capacity exceeded (`RATE_LIMITED`). Respect `Retry-After` / `error.retry_after_seconds`.

BadGatewayFailure.description: Upstream service unavailable (`UPSTREAM_UNAVAILABLE`) or returned unexpected structure (`UPSTREAM_INVALID_RESPONSE`).

ServiceUnavailableFailure.description: Platform adapter or required backend component is not configured (`SERVICE_NOT_CONFIGURED`), or per-platform circuit breaker / `disabled_platforms` fast-fail protection is open (`UPSTREAM_UNAVAILABLE`, `retryable: true`, with `Retry-After` header and `error.retry_after_seconds`).

GatewayTimeoutFailure.description: Upstream platform timed out within the server parse budget (`UPSTREAM_TIMEOUT`).

hdr_type.description: Omitted means unknown. hdr_unknown confirms HDR without a known type; it cannot prove coverage.

audio_language_role.description: Explicit upstream language role; requires audio_language. A track ID or non-default bitrate is not language evidence.

field_conflicts.description: Contradictory trusted observations for one media identity. The same field must be absent from scalar metadata; these observations cannot prove capability coverage.

fallback_urls.description: Bounded alternate credential URLs for the same logical source and HTTPS origin; primary remains authoritative.

direct_url.title: Direct Url
direct_url.description: Optional verified direct HTTPS upstream media URL alongside access="relay", for privileged/extension clients that can supply required Referer headers while keeping browser relay defaults unchanged.

PlatformQuery.description: Optional target platform ID from /api/platforms, or 'all' for automatic domain detection.

code.description: HTTP 401 always carries wire error code INVALID_INPUT.

retry_after_seconds.description: Positive integer backoff window in seconds matching the Retry-After HTTP header.

icon.description: Optional public asset path for the platform icon.

StatsPlatform.description: Core 14 platform identifier, 'unknown', bounded normalized long-tail extractor identifier (up to 64 distinct keys), 'ytdlp_unmatched', or 'ytdlp_other'.

count.description: Non-zero cumulative request count for this (platform, code, channel) cell.

anonymous.description: Cumulative parse/resolve requests without owner token.

owner.description: Cumulative parse/resolve requests authenticated via Bearer API credentials (DOKITOOL_OWNER_TOKEN or DOKITOOL_API_KEYS_FILE).

total.description: Total parse/resolve requests across all channels.

by_platform_code_channel.description: Non-zero cells sorted deterministically by (platform, code, channel).

hits.description: Direct fresh LRU response cache hits (`X-DokiTool-Cache: hit`).

stale_hits.description: Stale-if-error fallback cache hits served before media hard expiry (`X-DokiTool-Cache: stale`).

misses.description: Cache misses that executed an upstream parse/resolve.

singleflight_shared.description: Concurrent requests coalesced onto an in-flight parse/resolve.

uncacheable.description: Requests bypassing cache and singleflight (e.g. weibo, oversized input, or youtube when youtube_parse_ttl is 0s).

bytes.description: Current live serialized key+body byte usage.

active.description: Requests currently holding an execution slot in this pool.

queued.description: Requests currently waiting in this pool's FIFO queue.

concurrency_limit.description: Configured concurrency slot limit for this pool.

queue_limit.description: Configured FIFO queue capacity for this pool.

waited.description: Cumulative requests that entered the FIFO wait queue.

granted.description: Cumulative queued requests that acquired a slot before timeout.

timeout.description: Cumulative queued requests rejected with 429 after queue_wait expired.

full.description: Cumulative requests rejected immediately with 429 because the queue was full (or disabled).

canceled.description: Cumulative queued requests canceled by caller disconnect.

wait_ms_total.description: Cumulative milliseconds spent waiting in queue by granted/timed-out requests.

wait_ms_max.description: Maximum observed single-request queue wait in milliseconds.

sum_ms.description: Sum of observed durations in milliseconds.

wait_count.description: Cumulative acquisitions that contended and waited for a busy slot.

canceled_count.description: Cumulative slot waits canceled before acquisition.

wait_ms_total.description: Cumulative contended slot wait time in milliseconds.

wait_ms_max.description: Maximum contended slot wait time in milliseconds.

waiting.description: Callers currently waiting for a yt-dlp subprocess slot.

concurrency_limit.description: Configured yt-dlp subprocess concurrency limit (DOKITOOL_YTDLP_CONCURRENCY or DOKITOOL_YTDLP_GENERIC_CONCURRENCY).

fallbacks.description: Douyin parses that fell back to local backend resolution.

canceled.description: Shanghai tasks canceled due to caller disconnect.

queue_waits.description: Tasks that waited in the 300ms pull broker queue.

queue_granted.description: Queued tasks claimed by a Shanghai worker within budget.

queue_timeouts.description: Queued tasks that timed out of the 300ms broker wait and fell back.

waiting_workers.description: Idle shanghai-resolver pull workers currently long-polling for work.

queued_tasks.description: Unclaimed Douyin or Bilibili tasks currently waiting in the pull broker.

pending_tasks.description: Claimed Douyin or Bilibili tasks currently in flight on Shanghai workers.

APIKeyRole.description: Access role assigned to a configured Bearer API key.

id.description: Stable identifier of the configured API key ("owner" for the implicit DOKITOOL_OWNER_TOKEN key).

enabled.description: Whether this API key is currently enabled for authentication.

active.description: Requests currently holding an execution slot in this key's pool.

slow_active.description: Slow-engine (yt-dlp or YouTube helper) requests currently holding an execution slot in this key's pool.

queued.description: Requests currently waiting in this key's FIFO queue.

concurrency_limit.description: Configured total concurrency slot limit for this key.

slow_concurrency_limit.description: Configured slow-engine concurrency sub-limit for this key (0 means uncapped up to concurrency_limit).

queue_limit.description: Configured FIFO wait queue capacity for this key.

requests_total.description: Cumulative authenticated parse/resolve, platform-denied, and role-denied requests attributed to this key.

ok.description: Cumulative parser requests completed with HTTP status < 400 for this key.

errors.description: Cumulative parser requests completed with HTTP status >= 400 for this key.

cache_hits.description: Cumulative parse/resolve requests served via the post-auth zero-slot cache fast-path for this key.

rate_limited.description: Cumulative requests rejected with HTTP 429 by this key's rate bucket or queue limits.

unauthorized.description: Cumulative requests rejected with HTTP 401 due to role restriction (/api/stats) or per-key platform allowlist.

waited.description: Cumulative requests that entered this key's FIFO wait queue.

granted.description: Cumulative queued requests that acquired an execution slot before timeout.

timeout.description: Cumulative queued requests rejected with HTTP 429 after queue_wait expired.

full.description: Cumulative requests rejected immediately with HTTP 429 because this key's queue was full (or disabled).

canceled.description: Cumulative queued requests canceled due to caller disconnect.

wait_ms_total.description: Cumulative milliseconds spent waiting in this key's queue by granted or timed-out requests.

wait_ms_max.description: Maximum observed single-request queue wait in milliseconds for this key.

version.description: Compiled dokitool version identifier (defaults to 'unknown' when unset).

shanghai_bilibili.description: Whether Shanghai domestic Bilibili parallel resolution is enabled.

bilibili_dash.description: Whether Bilibili login-free DASH resolution is enabled.

youtube_helper.description: Whether YouTube browser helper endpoints are enabled.

xhs_transport.description: HTTPS transport profile used for Xiaohongshu page fetches.

ytdlp_enabled.description: Whether the external yt-dlp extractor engine is enabled.

ytdlp_generic_enabled.description: Whether Tier-2 named-extractor yt-dlp generic fallback (DOKITOOL_YTDLP_GENERIC_ENABLED) is active.

tbvideo_pipigx.description: Whether Pipigx watermark-free rewrite candidate metadata is enabled.

tbvideo_zuiyou.description: Whether Zuiyou watermark-free rewrite candidate metadata is enabled.

stats_persistence_enabled.description: Whether atomic stats snapshot persistence (DOKITOOL_STATS_SNAPSHOT_PATH) is enabled; never exposes the file path.

p50_ms.description: Estimated 50th percentile parse latency in milliseconds for this day (0 when no samples).

p95_ms.description: Estimated 95th percentile parse latency in milliseconds for this day (0 when no samples).

max_ms.description: Maximum observed parse latency in milliseconds for this day.

total.description: Total parse/resolve requests for this platform on this day.

ok.description: Successful (code='OK') parse/resolve requests for this platform on this day.

failed.description: Failed (non-'OK') parse/resolve requests for this platform on this day.

by_code.description: Non-zero outcome counts keyed by StatsOutcomeCode for this platform on this day.

p95_ms.description: Estimated 95th percentile parse latency in milliseconds for this platform on this day.

date.description: Asia/Shanghai (UTC+8) calendar date in YYYY-MM-DD format.

total.description: Total parse/resolve requests recorded on this Asia/Shanghai calendar date.

ok.description: Successful (code='OK') parse/resolve requests on this date.

failed.description: Failed (non-'OK') parse/resolve requests on this date.

cache_hits.description: Parse/resolve response cache hits recorded on this date.

shanghai_hits.description: Successful Shanghai domestic resolutions recorded on this date.

by_platform.description: Per-platform aggregate counts and latency summary for platforms with total > 0 on this date.

hour_start.description: Hour bucket start timestamp in RFC 3339 format with Asia/Shanghai (+08:00) offset.

total.description: Total parse/resolve requests recorded in this Asia/Shanghai hour bucket.

ok.description: Successful (code='OK') parse/resolve requests in this hour bucket.

failed.description: Failed (non-'OK') parse/resolve requests in this hour bucket.

cache_hits.description: Parse/resolve response cache hits recorded in this hour bucket.

enabled.description: Whether this isolated yt-dlp or YouTube EJS compartment is enabled.

active.description: Requests currently holding an execution slot in this compartment.

queued.description: Requests currently waiting in this compartment's FIFO queue.

concurrency_limit.description: Active concurrency slot limit for this compartment.

queue_limit.description: Active FIFO queue capacity for this compartment.

waited.description: Cumulative requests that entered this compartment's FIFO wait queue.

granted.description: Cumulative queued requests granted an execution slot.

timeout.description: Cumulative queued requests rejected with HTTP 429 on wait timeout.

full.description: Cumulative requests rejected immediately with HTTP 429 because the queue was full.

canceled.description: Cumulative queued requests canceled by caller disconnect.

wait_ms_total.description: Cumulative milliseconds spent waiting in this compartment's queue.

wait_ms_max.description: Maximum single-request wait time in milliseconds for this compartment.

window_failures.description: Genuine upstream/system failures inside the sliding evaluation window.

window_total.description: Total eligible outcomes recorded inside the sliding evaluation window.

open_until.description: RFC 3339 UTC timestamp when an automatic open circuit expires into half_open, or empty string when closed/half_open/disabled_by_config.

disabled_by_config.description: Whether this platform is manually forced open via runtime config circuit_breaker.disabled_platforms.

RuntimePolicyPlatform.description: Valid platform or internal Tier-2 generic scope identifier for runtime circuit_breaker.disabled_platforms.

config_file_active.description: Whether DOKITOOL_RUNTIME_CONFIG_FILE is active (never exposes the file path).

reload_count.description: Cumulative successful SIGHUP runtime policy reloads.

last_reloaded_at.description: RFC 3339 UTC timestamp of the most recent SIGHUP runtime policy reload, or empty string if never reloaded.

youtube_slots.description: Active YouTube yt-dlp compartment concurrency slots.

social_slots.description: Active Social yt-dlp compartment concurrency slots.

generic_slots.description: Active Tier-2 generic yt-dlp compartment concurrency slots.

youtube_ejs_concurrency.description: Active YouTube EJS helper admission pool concurrency.

fast_per_platform_max_concurrency.description: Active per-platform concurrency bulkhead cap in the fast parse pool.

circuit_breaker_enabled.description: Whether automatic per-platform circuit breaking is enabled.

disabled_platforms.description: Platforms manually forced into circuit-open protection via runtime config.

youtube_parse_ttl_seconds.description: Configured YouTube /api/parse server cache TTL cap in seconds (0 disables YouTube caching).

stale_if_error_ttl_seconds.description: Configured stale-if-error fallback window in seconds (clamped by earliest_expires_at - 15s; 0 disables stale fallback).

upstream_blocked_neg_ttl_seconds.description: Configured UPSTREAM_BLOCKED short negative cache TTL in seconds (0 disables).

circuit_breakers.description: Current circuit breaker state for all 14 core platforms in fixed canonical order.

api_keys.description: Per-key configuration and runtime telemetry for configured Bearer API keys (empty array when none configured; never exposes tokens or digests).

daily.description: Rolling Asia/Shanghai (UTC+8) daily aggregate buckets in ascending date order (up to 30 days).

hourly.description: Rolling Asia/Shanghai (UTC+8) hourly aggregate buckets in ascending hour_start order (up to 24 hours).
